name: PayPal

status.webhook_verification: Headers PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-ID/-TIME/-SIG/-CERT-URL/-AUTH-ALGO. Offline: RSA-verify PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG (base64) over 'transmissionId|transmissionTime|webhookId|crc32(RAW body)' using the cert at PAYPAL-CERT-URL (paypal.com only, cache it). Or online postback POST /v1/notifications/verify-webhook-signature (needs webhook_id; unsupported for the simulator). RAW body required for crc32.

credentials_required.label: Client ID
credentials_required.note: PayPal Developer dashboard → Apps & Credentials → your app → Client ID

credentials_required.label: Client Secret
credentials_required.note: same screen as the Client ID; used for OAuth2 Basic auth

credentials_required.label: Webhook ID
credentials_required.note: required to verify inbound webhook signatures (per merchant/app)

test_credentials.note: Sandbox client_id/secret are instant from developer.paypal.com → Apps & Credentials → Sandbox; live needs a verified Business account + KYC

test_cards.result: success (generated in Sandbox → Testing Tools → Credit Card Generator)

sandbox.notes: Testing Tools → Sandbox Accounts gives a business (seller) and a personal (buyer w/ balance) account. Approve an order by logging into the personal account at sandbox.paypal.com/checkoutnow?token=<orderId>. The webhook simulator exists but online postback verify is NOT supported there — use offline crypto verification.

pain_points.problem: Order marked paid on APPROVED — merchant ships but no money arrives
pain_points.cause: For intent=CAPTURE, CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED means the buyer approved but funds are NOT captured yet
pain_points.mitigation: Map paid ONLY to a capture COMPLETED; auto-capture (POST /v2/checkout/orders/{id}/capture) on ORDER.APPROVED for CAPTURE intent, then fulfil on PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED

pain_points.cause: The crc32 is computed over a re-serialised JSON body instead of the raw bytes
pain_points.mitigation: Capture the RAW request body before any JSON parser; build the message 'transmissionId|time|webhookId|crc32(rawBody)' and RSA-verify with the cached cert

pain_points.cause: Requesting a new OAuth token on every call, or reusing an expired one
pain_points.mitigation: Central token cache keyed by (env, client_id), single-flight refresh at ~80% of expires_in (token lasts ~9h)

pain_points.cause: Online postback requires the merchant's webhook_id and does not work from the webhook simulator
pain_points.mitigation: Store webhook_id per merchant; default to OFFLINE crypto verification which also works with simulated events

pain_points.problem: Duplicate orders / double captures on retry
pain_points.cause: Network retries re-POST create-order or capture
pain_points.mitigation: Send a stable PayPal-Request-Id (idempotency key) on create/capture/refund; dedupe inbound webhooks by event id

pain_points.problem: Sandbox creds hit the live host (or vice-versa) → 401
pain_points.cause: Wrong base URL for the environment
pain_points.mitigation: Select api-m.sandbox.paypal.com for test vs api-m.paypal.com for live from an env flag; validate creds with a token call on connect

notes: Zimbabwe PayPal accounts are historically RESTRICTED to send-only — a ZW merchant generally CANNOT receive/withdraw PayPal funds without an entity in a supported country. Verify merchant receive capability before going live; sandbox testing works fine regardless. Two-step flow: create order → buyer approves (redirect) → capture. APPROVED is never money; only a capture COMPLETED is settled funds.

verification.verified_notes: OAuth token + Orders v2 create-order verified live against the sandbox (real order id + approve URL).
unverified_fields: webhook offline-signature verification against a real event
